svg.title: Stepping between zones with the keyboard in Zonogy. While the modifier keys are held, each arrow key moves a circle to the next zone in that direction. Releasing over an empty zone makes it the destination and opens the Launcher there. Releasing over a window's zone focuses that window.
svg.text: Hold the modifier keys and press arrows: a circle steps between zones
Release on an empty zone to make it the destination, with the Launcher
Release on a window's zone to focus that window
